post_merge_verification: Read actual PR merge state and public head; preserve original branch.
Fetch actual landed main/merge commit, require exact expected whole tree and b304/main ancestry.
Require original author field/message and one ordered replay commit; preserve new committer/time separately.
Require verifier receipt resolves and corroborates exact696, all six changed entries arrived and no absent/moved-on entries.
If main/head or expected union changed, perform a bounded interaction review rather than infer unchanged approval.
pre_release_requirements: Root reads prepared artifacts and explicitly releases publication/readiness/merge.
Actual external full-source final verdict approves the exact committed six-file source; no timeout or partial review counts.
Canonical native and external exact-head comments are published/read back with actual current GitHub actor permission; any true refusal must be resolved.
Read current PR state/head/base and main to confirm this prepared union still applies; PR must no longer be draft at merge.
Do not set GH_MERGE_VERIFIED_REMOTE, GH_MERGE_VERIFIED_SELFCHECK or any guard-bypass/fixture option.
admission_scope: Current-main verifier checks its own source and canonical review authority; no whole-DAG receipt is introduced as a prerequisite. --expect-head corroborates the fetched PR head; the inspected version does not pass --match-head-commit to gh, so continued exclusive ownership/head freshness and post-merge content verification remain necessary.
